title: Runtime Traceback Self-Healing
description: A committed edit references an undefined `DEFAULT_ALPHA` constant, so smoke preflight fails with a Python NameError in the isolated worktree. The host must turn the traceback into a minimal `file_edits` patch, re-verify smoke, pass the approval gate, and only then execute the grid.

injected_fault.detail: Reference an undefined DEFAULT_ALPHA constant in the argparse default

user_prompt: The host smoke run hit a NameError. Diagnose it, propose the minimal fix, and run the 3-window grid once approved.
forbidden_hallucinations: reporting metrics from a run that never passed smoke
describing a fix that was not applied inside the worktree

ground_truth_assertions.description: Smoke preflight fails with a NameError on the undefined DEFAULT_ALPHA constant
The file_edits candidate passes smoke inside the isolated worktree before approval
No fix is written into the user main working tree
The executed grid selects the calibrated best window
Task reaches Completed with fresh evidence
